_doc: gr2_lint profiles of the Koreans add-on's own building models (AoP scripts/havok/gr2_lint.py --profiles tools/gr2_lint/profiles.json --profile <name> art/buildings/<folder>/). It extends AoP's profile file: the owner's texture classes and the DLL tool route come from there and are never redefined here. Relative paths resolve from this repository.

tools._owner_messages_doc: the owner's verbatim answers this add-on's profiles cite (confirmed_by, waivers)

korean_house_a._doc: Korean House A (Colonial on), texture-r14 source; donor graph: vanilla japan_shrine_age2_01(_damaged). Intact + damaged + HKT + materials + animfile.

texture_budget._doc: owner 2026-10-09 (tools/gr2_lint/owner_authorization.json): House A/B/C = large - the WALLS 2048 + ROOFS 2048 pages, one set for all three variants and every stage; the shared r65 atlas and the TC pottery page are pinned shared dependencies, not counted

authorization.owner_quote: - Owned textures across **all three together**: one WALLS 2048² set and one ROOFS 2048² set. Reuse the exact Korean shared matc r65 1024² and existing TC pottery page. No additional construction, hidden-face or per-variant texture pages. Refer to shared runtime resources once; never copy vanilla assets into the mod.

physical_mounts._doc: the small garrison mast (flag 0.7 scale): end rings measured on the r14 source; damaged: the reserved donor body holds the pole only

korean_house_a_con._doc: Korean House A construction p66 (the only authored stage; p0/p33 are vanilla): linted as the intact stage of this file. No flag, mast or pottery: the bone set has no flag bone. r14b: every new member face keeps a positive UV winding (AoP uv_integrity W); the r14 members were mirrored.
